global.note: independent_countable counts rows on the exhibit pages and excludes entries flagged non-English, entries whose author list no source has settled, and (per the user's decision on 2026-11-05) entries that do not stand for their work because Google Scholar lists the same paper twice against the same cited paper. It is therefore the number of yellow marks printed on the filed exhibits, and it counts citations rather than papers. Per the guide a non-English citation needs a certified human translation and affidavit before it may be counted. independent_unique_papers is the same counted-citation basis after duplicate listings are dropped -- despite the name it is NOT a paper count; distinct_citing_papers and distinct_independent_papers are the true paper counts and are the figures to quote when stating how many papers cite this work. Per the user's decision on 2026-11-01 no certified translations are being obtained, so every non-English entry is left unhighlighted and the english_* columns are the adjusted English-only figures the guide asks for; non_english_withheld is the count of entries that look independent and corroborated but are withheld for language. secondary_copy_independent is the independent rows held back only because they do not stand for their work, named separately so they are never mistaken for unsettled author work. The english_* denominator is the English rows on the citing lists, because Google Scholar publishes no English-only total for a profile.
